statement: The ProjectionReadinessEvidenceOwner semantic generation for a node is a pure function of that node's OWN observed semantic inputs S(N) = {dimensions, runtimeAuthority, priorityControlPlaneRecovery, runtimeServeEligible, nodeEvidence, membershipPublication} — every field canonically digested with observation-time fields excluded (membershipPublication via a digest cached per frozen diagnostics object, its top-level createdAt/updatedAt classified observation-time) — and carries NO cluster-wide version segment and NO planning-derivation segment, so an authoritative mutation rotates node N's generation if and only if it changes N's observed semantic inputs. Invariants: (DEP-SCOPE) every field reaching the owner seam is classified with a source-owner justification and the seam fails CLOSED (build without memoizing, counted) for any unclassified field or digest depth overflow; (A1) a mutation proven to affect only node A rotates A while B returns the SAME core reference without normalizing again; (A2) A observes the new semantic result — no stale node-local entry; (A3) a membership-publication content change (epoch/status/ack lists) rotates every node's generation, while a CONTROL_PLANE_PUBLICATIONS write that leaves the membership diagnostics' semantic content unchanged rotates no node; (A4) a mutation affecting a bounded node subset rebuilds exactly that subset; (A5) live transport/lifecycle/publication-mode/repair changes rotate exactly as v2 DEP and v4 established, raw nodeEvidence transport fields included; (A6) a publication change arriving while a graph is being built, or between a cache apply and its deferred listener on the sync path, never publishes old evidence under a newer generation, on the REAL SystemTableCache; (PLANNING) a planning-derivation tick that changes no verdict leaves every core reused by reference and a planning change that flips a verdict still rotates through the digested verdict; (ENGAGEMENT) under production-shaped churn (five nodes, moving clock, writes repeatedly concerning one/some nodes, planning latch live) unaffected nodes' cores actually reuse, and the receipt reds when either the six cluster-wide table versions or the planning segment is restored to the key; (BOUNDED-WORK) builds(N) <= changes to S(N) + 1 initial build — never cluster table writes x node count; (LIVE) on the local docker formation fixture (LAGRANGE_LOOP_GAP_PROFILE=1 npm run demo:movielens, seed node, formation window) owner reuse is >= 50% with builds per sync read <= 0.35, against 8.8% and 0.55 measured before. The generation uses no TTL, clock, evaluation count or object identity as an invalidation signal (a WeakMap digest cache on frozen objects is a pure cache). Scope owns ONLY the generation of the ProjectionReadinessEvidenceOwner and the sync publication-diagnostics memo keying; it does NOT own the planning latch itself, OwnerKeyReconcileQueue cadence, ReadinessPlanningSnapshotOwner loop frequency, trust-state/dispatch caller frequency, candidate-derivation self-cost, storage_reservation_reconcile, or schema admission.
